contract.proof: Vue delegates the explicit prop-replacement boundary to Core collection reconciliation and retains only the resulting controller snapshot.
contract.adversarialWitness: A disjoint equal-size prop replacement invalidates selection and current while visiting every external option once.

fullScan.rationale: External option replacement requires validation; ordinary controller events bypass this path.

variables.name: sForm
variables.meaning: active subscribers on the form channel

variables.name: sField
variables.meaning: active subscribers for one field identifier

contract.proof: Each composable owns one shallowRef and one DOM Form selector subscription; field selectors bind directly to the field-ID channel and all reconnect cleanup uses one retained disposer.
contract.adversarialWitness: A field update with unrelated field subscribers must invoke only the changed field channel and form selectors whose selected value changes.

fullScan.rationale: The Vue bridge neither scans FormState.fields nor materializes the complete state projection.

assumptions: getKey resolver identity remains stable across the external array replacement
contract.proof: A stable key resolver discovers the changed keyed window with one prefix/suffix identity scan, validates only inserted identities, and delegates the splice to Core's bounded Sequence overlay instead of allocating another complete ID snapshot.
contract.adversarialWitness: A one-item insertion at the start of a maxItems array must compare the retained suffix but allocate only one inserted ID and bounded patch metadata.

fullScan.rationale: A raw external array replacement has no trusted patch descriptor, so semantic change discovery may inspect every retained item identity; allocation remains proportional to the changed keyed window.

contract.proof: ResizeObserver callbacks enqueue only changed entries; keyed value replacements may inspect the currently mounted identities to schedule forced measurements, and one coalesced batch performs at most one Virtual measurement mutation and placement publication.
contract.adversarialWitness: Every mounted row changes value identity while one ResizeObserver batch reports every mounted element.

fullScan.rationale: Measurement may visit the mounted render window but cannot inspect unmounted collection items.
